test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the area of the circle whose circumference is 22 cm.
solution:
Let radius be r,

Given circumference = 2πr = 22

⇒ r = 22/2π = 7/2 cm

Area can be given as πr²

⇒ Area = π(3.5)² 

⇒ Area = 22/7 × 12.25 

⇒ Area = 38.5 cm2

∴ The area of circle is 38.5 cm²

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
